column1: # ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49 (V2) custom partition table - 16 MB flash
# Why not the menu option "16M Flash (3MB APP/9.9MB FATFS)" (app3M_fat9M_16MB)?
#   That gives a 9 MB FAT partition which this project NEVER uses: music and
#   lyrics live on the microSD card (esp_vfs_fat_sdmmc_mount("/sdcard"))
#   the on-board FAT partition wastes 9 MB while the app only gets 3 MB.
# Why the app needs to grow:
#   The CJK font set went from "GB2312 level-1 only" to the full GB2312
#   (6763 hanzi + 682 symbols + Latin-1 + music/star symbols = 7840 glyphs).
#   Font bitmaps grew 1.31 MB -> 2.15 MB and the app is now ~3.9 MB
#   longer fits in 3 MB.  (Also worth knowing: LVGL's
#   lv_font_fmt_txt_glyph_dsc_t.bitmap_index is only 20 bits
#   font bitmap must stay below 1 MB - that is why the 20 px font is split
#   into a primary + a fallback face.)
# Result: app 3 MB -> 2 x 7 MB (dual OTA slots kept
# How it is used: the Arduino core prefers a partitions.csv located in the
#   SKETCH directory over the menu selection
#   (see platform.txt
#   PartitionScheme=custom.
# NOTE: keep this file ASCII-only and WITHOUT a BOM.
#   tools/gen_esp32part.py checks line[0] == '#' to skip comments
#   BOM makes the first line look like data and the build fails with
#   "Field 'type' can't be left empty".  A BOM-free but non-ASCII file is also
#   risky because that script reads the file with the system default encoding.
# Name
nvs
otadata
app0
app1
